resolution: A — Clarity Pro Plus IS entitled to RDN Statistics Push

subtasks.title: Entitle Clarity Pro Plus to RDN Statistics Push on both gates, and give the toggle real feedback
subtasks.approach: Add ProTierEnum::CLARITY_PRO_PLUS to the two hand-duplicated tier allow-lists that gate RDN Statistics Push — the write gate in Subscription::toggleRdnMetricsPush() and the read gate in DispatchRdnMetricsHourly::eligibleOrgs() — changed together so the toggle's promise is honored end-to-end. Independently, replace the action's silent `return;` rejections with visible feedback and add a success notification, using the app's existing Filament Notification::make()->title(...)->success()/->danger()->send() convention (app/Filament/Pages/Roles.php). TDD: write the failing Pro Plus toggle test and the failing dispatcher-eligibility test FIRST, confirm red, then make them green. The Blade needs no change: under Resolution A the entitled set is exactly the non-BASIC tiers, so the existing `$currentTier !== BASIC` render condition and the widened allow-list now agree in effect.

intended_diffs.app/Filament/Pages/Subscription.php: Line 194: add ProTierEnum::CLARITY_PRO_PLUS to the in_array allow-list. Lines 186-217: send a Filament success Notification after the write ('RDN Statistics Push enabled/disabled'), and replace each bare `return;` with a ->danger() notification before returning (non-admin path at :188-190, non-entitled-tier path at :194-196) so no click is ever silent. Preserve the existing activity('rdn_metrics_toggle') audit entry and the $this->rdnMetricsPushEnabled assignment exactly as-is.
intended_diffs.app/Jobs/Rdn/DispatchRdnMetricsHourly.ph: Lines 105-109: add ProTierEnum::CLARITY_PRO_PLUS to the PHP-side in_array tier filter in eligibleOrgs(). No other change — the SQL predicates, the rdn_id trim, and the pending-downgrade rationale comment all stay.
intended_diffs.tests/Filament/Pages/SubscriptionTest.ph: Add to the existing #[Group('rdn-metrics')] block: (a) a CLARITY_PRO_PLUS admin can toggle on — asserts rdnMetricsPushEnabled flips, org_meta persists, and the rdn_metrics_toggle activity entry is written, mirroring test_admin_can_toggle_rdn_metrics_push_on; (b) the same for toggle off; (c) mount() reads the flag back for a Pro Plus org (AC4); (d) a successful toggle sends a success notification (assertNotified); (e) a non-admin's call sends a danger notification and does not write. Set the tier explicitly via org_meta platform_repo_pro_tier — createUser(pro: true) defaults to CLARITY_PRO and will NOT reach the Pro Plus path.
intended_diffs.tests/Feature/RdnMetrics/DispatchRdnMetr: Add a CLARITY_PRO_PLUS case using the existing makeRdnEligibleOrg(ProTierEnum::CLARITY_PRO_PLUS, optedIn: true, rdnId: ...) helper, asserting the org IS included in the hourly dispatch — the read/write gate parity test that prevents this bug class from recurring.

blast_radius: billing-adjacent: Subscription page / paid-tier entitlement (platform_repo_pro* org_meta keys)

deliberate_deferrals.item: De-duplicate the entitled-tier set into a single ProTierEnum helper (e.g. ProTierEnum::allowsRdnMetricsPush()) used by the write gate, the read gate, and the Blade render condition.
deliberate_deferrals.reason: This is the durable structural fix for the bug class (two hand-maintained lists plus a third render condition that drifted), but it is not needed for any AC and would widen a 4-file bug fix into an enum + call-site refactor. Under Resolution A no user-visible divergence remains, and the new parity test catches future drift. Recorded here so review sees this as a considered decision, not an oversight; will be raised as a linked follow-up Jira task at handoff.

deliberate_deferrals.item: admin_impersonator bypass on the tier gate.
deliberate_deferrals.reason: Explicitly declined by Dalton in the Phase 2 interview — an entitlement bypass on a paid-tier gate is its own ticket.

notes: Single-node DAG: every change lands in one method plus one job filter plus their two test files. Fanning out would put two workers in the same method — serialized by design, so Phase 4 takes the single-node fast path in REPO_PATH.
Sizing gate: 4 files, one concern (RDN toggle entitlement parity + its missing feedback). Under the 6-file threshold; no split recommended.
Perf gate: not required — perf_validation.required = false. No >1B-row ClickHouse surface is introduced or re-shaped; the only CH involvement is the existing hourly job's already-scoped reads.

Scale note for the Build Record: widening eligibility means more orgs enter the hourly dispatcher, which increases read volume against clarity.scan_report_hourly and clarity.hits_hot on the existing hourly cadence. Bounded by the number of Pro Plus orgs that opt in — a capacity footnote, not a design risk.
Review: escalate to 3 lanes — the diff touches paid-tier entitlement (auth/permission-adjacent territory) and carries a blast-radius tag.
